CODE
Art. 2.3.50. 
Net partition
If any assets remain, they are divided by half.
Each spouse is liable for any joint debts remaining after the partition out of all his or her property.
However, each spouse is liable for common debts for the payment of which his or her own patrimony could not be pursued during the regime only to the extent of what he or she received at the time of the partition.
In the absence of any other provision in the partition deed, a spouse who pays a common debt after the partition has recourse against the other spouse up to the amount of half of what he or she has paid.
Unless otherwise agreed, each spouse contributes half of the costs of liquidation and division.
